artifacts.delta_brief: Between 2023 and 2024, KO continues to emphasize supply_chain as core risk exposure (2023 para 19; 2024 para 17). The earlier filing is relatively more anchored in supply_chain, while the later filing adds clearer weight to supply_chain (2023 para 6; 2024 para 53). Across both years, management frames these items as operational and financial execution pressures rather than isolated one-off events (2023 para 19; 2024 para 53). This comparison should be read as directional because the lens is a focuspack subset and not the full Item 1A text (2023 para 6; 2024 para 17). Overall, the narrative indicates continuity with selective shifts in emphasis instead of a full thematic reset (2023 para 19; 2024 para 17).
